verdict.rationale: This axis applies because Yubico exposes a programmatic REST surface: the YubiEnterprise API docs are public at console.yubico.com/apidocs/. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.yubico.com returned 404, and Yubico's docs are described as human-oriented HTML only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
